channel.title: Embedded-Cybersecurity on Hardware Hacking Laboratory
channel.description: Recent content in Embedded-Cybersecurity on Hardware Hacking Laboratory

item.title: FramaCovr: from Frama-C coverage to the gcovr format
item.description: H2Lab releases FramaCovr, a tool that converts Frama-C metrics coverage reports into the gcovr format.

item.title: New Technical Guide: A Methodology for Selecting Security Components
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide providing a complete methodology for selecting, integrating, and auditing hardware security building blocks in embedded products.

item.title: New Technical Guide: Secure Bare-Metal Firmware Development in C
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide on secure bare-metal firmware development in C for constrained embedded microcontrollers.

item.title: New Technical Guide: Securing the JTAG/SWD Interface for Embedded Systems
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide dedicated to securing JTAG/SWD debug interfaces in critical embedded systems.

item.title: New Technical Guide: Physical Protection Mechanisms for Embedded Systems
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide on physical protection mechanisms for embedded equipment, from enclosure security to secure boot.

item.title: New Technical Guide: Secure update of embedded systems
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide on microcontroller dual-bank based secure upgrade

item.title: New Technical Guide: Physical Memory Protection for Embedded Systems
item.description: Publication of a new STIG guide on microcontroller memory protection and the use of the MPU as a defensible security control.
